milestones.title: Publish the society’s first website
milestones.description: Provide membership information, project briefs, event plans, leadership openings, and links to official 3-2 resources.

milestones.title: Recruit the founding group
milestones.description: Collect member interests, discuss leadership capacity, and identify students willing to own the first tasks.

milestones.title: Hold the first member meeting
milestones.description: Confirm a room, date, agenda, access information, and a clear decision process for first-year priorities.

milestones.title: Select one or two first projects
milestones.description: Choose projects only after a lead, team, scope, tools, safety plan, and first milestone are defined.

milestones.title: Run the first practical program
milestones.description: Test one 3-2 planning conversation, build session, or speaker event and gather participant feedback.

milestones.title: Publish a short founding-term report
milestones.description: Record what happened, what did not happen, participation counts, project status, spending, and next steps.
